protocol_content.title: Tenecteplase for imaging-selected acute ischemic stroke in the 4.5-to-24-hour window
protocol_content.research_question: Among adults with imaging-selected acute ischemic stroke presenting 4.5 to 24 hours after last known well, compare intravenous tenecteplase with the randomized control treatment for the efficacy and safety outcomes defined by the Review.
protocol_content.review_criteria: Include randomized controlled trials of imaging-selected adults with acute ischemic stroke treated 4.5 to 24 hours after last known well that compare intravenous tenecteplase with placebo or medical control. Collect the functional, imaging, neurological and safety outcomes specified by the Review using outcome-specific participant counts and denominators.

result_targets.population: Adults with imaging-selected acute ischemic stroke presenting 4.5 to 24 hours after last known well in randomized controlled trials.
result_targets.outcome_definition: Modified Rankin Scale score 0 or 1 at 90 days.
result_targets.analysis_population: Participants analyzed in the randomized groups for the selected outcome.
result_targets.selection_rule: Use the randomized comparison and extract the outcome-specific participant counts and denominators at the Review-defined timepoint using the endpoint definition reported by each trial.
